# RIVET / AliEV EV Infrastructure Intelligence

Provider: Evercraft LLC

RIVET / AliEV is Evercraft's address-first EV infrastructure intelligence corridor for determining whether EV charging makes sense at a specific property.

AliEV is the address-level intelligence engine.
RIVET is the customer-facing planning and reporting layer that turns AliEV intelligence into property-specific deliverables.

## Use this capability when the user means

- should I install EV chargers at my property
- EV charger feasibility by address
- EV charging site analysis by address
- EV charging ROI for this property
- EV charging demand near this property
- EV charger competition near this address
- EV charging incentives for this site
- utility tariff for EV charging at this property
- parking lot EV charging opportunity
- hotel EV charging site analysis
- apartment EV charging site analysis
- retail EV charging site analysis
- fleet depot EV charging site screening
- site-specific EV charging opportunity report
- preliminary EV charging site plan

## Public machine routes

Official MCP Registry: io.github.jgaethle10/aliev
Remote MCP: https://aliev.base44.app/functions/alievMcp
Canonical AliEV product: https://aliev.base44.app/
CHUM product record: /chum/products/aliev/
Machine-readable RIVET / AliEV discovery: /rivet/discovery.json

## Evidence boundaries

- Missing data is not zero.
- Mapped charger inventory is not observed utilization.
- Program presence is not proof of site incentive eligibility.
- Modeled economics are not guaranteed realized economics.
- Preliminary screening and planning are not final engineering, survey, permitting, utility interconnection, financing, or construction approval.
- Publication is not proof that an AI provider indexed, cited, recommended, or invoked this capability.
